title: Manufacturer Copay Card Counter Limit and the Deductible on the Claim — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
**Clause.** The counter limit of a Manufacturer Copay Card of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs — the most the benefit base is allowed to count — follows the plan and the deductible on the claim: a **Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan** claim with **2000.00 dollars or more** of deductible has a limit of **2500.00 dollars**; a **Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan** claim with **less than 2000.00 dollars of deductible but some** (0.01 to 1999.99 dollars) has **1500.00 dollars**; and every other claim has the program's per-fill benefit maximum.

The plan is the class of the coverage record under Prescription Insurance on File that the card is linked to; the deductible is the deductible recorded on the latest paid insurance claim of the card's prescription.

| Claim | Counter limit |
|---|---|
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan, deductible $2000.00 or more | $2500.00 |
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan, deductible $0.01 to $1999.99 | $1500.00 |
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan, no deductible on the claim | the program's per-fill benefit maximum |
| Any other plan | the program's per-fill benefit maximum |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical high-deductible claims).** Deductible $1999.99: $1500.00. Deductible $2000.00: $2500.00. Deductible $0.00: the program's per-fill benefit maximum.
